observations: Two road bicycles leaning against a wire mesh fence.
The bicycle in the foreground has a black frame with 'YAMADA' visible on the down tube.
The bicycle in the background has a light grey or white frame with drop handlebars.
Both bicycles feature drop handlebars with grip tape (black on the black bike, white on the light bike).
The tires on the light-colored bicycle appear heavily soiled or aged.
A prominent watermark 'STACEY DAVIES' is visible across the center of the image.
The background shows a stack of car tires and a paved ground surface.

claims.evidence: The tires on the white bicycle appear dirty or aged, and the image resolution is too low to confirm the cleanliness of the frames.

risks.risk: Mechanical condition of the drivetrain (gears, chain, derailleurs).
risks.proof: Close-up photos of the derailleurs and a video of the gears shifting through all positions.
A video showing the brake levers engaging the calipers and stopping the wheels.

risks.risk: Authenticity of the listing and possession of the items.
risks.proof: A photo of the bicycles with a handwritten note showing the seller's name and the current date.

proof_requests: Clear, high-resolution individual photos of each bicycle.
Close-up photos of the gear systems (derailleurs, cassettes, and shifters).
A photo of the bicycles with a handwritten note of today's date to verify possession, given the watermark.
Clear photos of the brand and model names on both frames.
response.reason: The single photo provided is of low quality and contains a watermark ('STACEY DAVIES') that is inconsistent with a local private sale, suggesting the image may be from an external source. Additionally, the seller mentions 'differ prices' for the two units, but the photo does not provide enough detail on the components or the second bike's brand to distinguish their values.
